Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at North America?

In the A-26 schedule, 43 stations broadcast aimed at North America. The most heavily scheduled include Radio Habana Cuba, Various pirates, Radio Exterior España, Radio Marti.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at North America?

The most-used frequencies are 9710, 11880, 15140, 5850, 15500 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
